subject.title: feat(gateway): durable cloud worker environments, provider SDK contract, and lifecycle RPCs

question: Should OpenClaw commit now to this cloud-worker configuration, plugin SDK, persistent-state, and gateway RPC contract as the public foundation for the remaining worker milestones?
rationale: Fixing the code defects does not decide whether these long-lived public and security-sensitive contracts should ship before the later bootstrap, tunnel, protocol, and dispatch milestones.

options.title: Approve after repair and proof
options.body: Keep this architecture, fix the blockers, and require upgrade, security, and real lifecycle evidence before merge.

options.title: Narrow the first slice
options.body: Merge only internal durable-state groundwork and defer public config, plugin SDK, and RPC commitments.

options.title: Defer the foundation
options.body: Keep the design issue open but postpone implementation until later milestones can be reviewed together.

recommendation.title: Approve after repair and proof
recommendation.body: Keep this architecture, fix the blockers, and require upgrade, security, and real lifecycle evidence before merge.
